newsitem.title: CHINA: Group forms for IBK US$50 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for IBK US$50 mln FRN.

text.p: A syndicate group has formed for Industrial Bank of Korea's US$50 million floating rate notes issue due July 2000, arranger Sanwa International Finance said on Monday.
The three-year notes, which were launched earlier on Monday, have annual put and call options.
They were issued at par to float at 25 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for co-lead manager is 27 basis points.
The notes were issued under the bank's US$1.0 billion global medium-term note programme.
Three financial institutions in addition to the arranger joined the syndication.
ABN AMRO Hoare Govett, Daiwa Securities (HK) and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell are co-lead managers and each of them committed US$10 million to the issue.
